name: Classy apartment "Palazzo"
description:
Ideally located on the middle ridge of a panoramic hill descending into the Iseo lake, the Residence Ca' laRipa provides a breathtaking view over the surrounding area. The apartment is part of a renovated old family house dating 1791.

CIR: 016200-CNI-00005
CIN: IT016200C2UGHHFQTY
neighborhood_overview:
One of the highlights of lake Iseo is Montisola, the largest lake island in Europe. The highly naturalistic area also allows for sport and leisure activities, such as horse riding, mountain-biking, sailing, kayaking, to mention a few.

In addition, cultural and historical towns such as Lovere and Sarnico provide you with a large offer of concerts, shopping, swimming-pools, and restaurants.

Finally, the Camonica valley will amaze you with its rock carvings from the stone-age, and its mountains which offer several opportunities for hiking or skiing all year long.
host_about:

It all started back in 2005 when my parents renovated our old family house to provide the very same kind of hospitality they wanted to experience when travelling. 

And after several years abroad, it is now the turn of the new generation to take over.  You are welcome to Residenza Ca’ laRipa!

description: Just 20 mins from the Orio al Serio airport, and 1 h from Milan. Once an 18th Century residence, set on a hill and surrounded by a large garden and vineyards. Ideal for group holidays, for families, for team building, retreats, workshops and for people who just love wine!
neighborhood_overview:
Just a short walk away from the villa is the "Frasca San Nicola", a restaurant offering excellent Italian cuisine in the Bergamo tradition located in a unique setting: the Cloister of the former Convent of St. Nicholas, inhabited once upon a time by Augustinian monks, and part of the Church of Our Lady of Consolation. It is a perfect example of Romanesque architecture, containing a rare and perfectly preserved example of an Antegnati organ.
Furthermore, the cellars of the former convent still produce Lurani Cernuschi wine, and guests can participate in wine tasting and learn about the vineyard’s details and history. Indeed, it feels like stepping back in time to the 1400s to stroll along the ancient Contrada della Porta to the vineyards!

host_about:
Sono le 7 del mattino e la sveglia suona... Anche oggi è ora di andare a scuola!
Ebbene sì: ho trenta anni compiuti e ancora vado a scuola. Spero non pensiate che io sia un'alunna pluriripetente... Sono un'insegnante di lettere!
Amo il mio lavoro, amo le materie che insegno e amo i miei studenti!
Certo, alcune ore sembrano non passare mai (soprattutto quelle di grammatica e analisi logica durante le quali i poveri studenti, e con loro la docente, si struggono nel tentativo di studiare e analizzare la sintassi di centinaia di frasi!) e certo alcuni alunni, quelli più "vivaci", sono spesso causa di forti mal di gola e nottate insonni!
Ma, nonostante piccole sorvolabili pecche, insegnare mi piace e mi piace tutto il tempo libero che questo lavoro concede! Ho diversi hobbies e passioni: mi piace ascoltare musica di tutti i generi, guardare vecchi film, leggere romanzi. Adoro ballare (sin da piccola ho frequentato corsi di danza classica, balli latinoamericani e hip hop), nuotare, sciare. Ho serie difficoltà, questo lo devo confessare, con il tennis e la pallavolo!
La mia più grande passione, però, è un'altra: viaggiare. Tre magliette, tre calzini, tre mutande, tre pantaloni, un paio di scarpe comode, lo spazzolino da denti e... via! Città d'Italia, capitali d'Europa o paesi oltreoceano, ogni viaggio è una grande emozione. E come qualcuno ha detto "La vera casa dell'uomo non è una casa, è la strada. E la vita stessa è un viaggio, da fare a piedi".

HOLA!
Son las 7 de la mañana y suena el despertador. Incluso hoy sigue siendo la hora de ir a la escuela. Y bien… he cumplido treinta años y todavía voy al colegio. Espero que no penséis que soy una perpetua repetidora… ¡Soy una profesora de literatura! Adoro mi trabajo, me encanta la materia que enseño y me encantan mis estudiantes. Aunque claro, hay algunas horas que parecen no pasar nunca (sobre todo las de gramática y análisis de lógica durante las cuales los pobres estudiantes y su profesora parecen consumirse en un intento de estudiar y analizar la sintaxis de cientos de frases. Es verdad que algunos alumnos, los más ‘pillos’, son a menudo la causa de un cierto dolor de garganta y algo de insomnio. Pero de todas formas son cosas que se pueden obviar porque me gusta enseñar y disfruto con todo el tiempo libre que este trabajo concede. 

Tengo diversos hobbies y pasiones: me gusta escuchar música de todos los géneros, ver películas clásicas y leer novelas. Adoro bailar (desde pequeña he ido a cursos de baile clásico, ritmos latinos y hip hop), y también me gusta nadar y esquiar. Debo confesar que tengo serias dificultades con el tenis y el voleibol. Pero sin embargo y por encima de cualquier otra cosa, mi principal pasión es viajar. Tres camisetas, tres pares de calcetines, tres bragas, tres pantalones, un par de zapatos cómodos, el cepillo de dientes y ¡en marcha! Ciudades de Italia, capitales de Europa o países transoceánicos., cada viaje es una gran emoción. Es como lo que dijo alguien una vez ‘la verdadera casa del hombre no es una casa, es la calle. Y la vida misma es un viaje para hacerlo a pie’. 

HELLO, I’M ANNA!
It is 7 am and the alarm rings... It's time to go to school! Yes, I'm thirty years old and I'm still going to school. I hope you do not think I'm a failing student... I am a literature teacher! I love my job, I love the subjects I teach and I love my students! Sure, some hours seem endless (especially those of grammar and syntax, during which the poor students, and the teacher with them, struggle to study and analyze the syntax of hundreds of sentences!) And of course some students, the more “lively,” often cause severe sore throat and sleepless nights!
But despite some small flaws, I like teaching and I love all the free time that my work allows me! I have many hobbies and passions: I like listening to music (all kinds of music!), watching old movies, reading novels. I love dancing (when I was younger I took ballet, Caraibic and hip-hop classes), swimming and skiing. Though I must confess I’m not a confident tennis and volleyball player! 
My greatest passion, however, is another one: traveling. Three t-shirts, three pair of socks, three trousers, a comfortable pair of shoes, a toothbrush and... I'm ready to go! Italian cities, European capitals, or overseas countries, every trip is a thrill! And as someone said, "The real home of a human being is not a house, it’s the road. And life itself is a journey—by foot."

My father, an architect and avid watch collector, and my daughter Ginevra, who is named after the Swiss city, were the sources of inspiration for the creation of this unique establishment. My father's architecture studio was transformed into a refined location inspired by the world's most famous watches.
neighborhood_overview:
Ginevra Rooms is located on the fifth floor of a building overlooking the spacious and peaceful Piazza della Repubblica, along the historic Viale Vittorio Emanuele. This privileged location places the building on the same urban transport line (bus nr.1) that connects the medieval Upper Town to the train station. Moreover, the shuttle to the airport departs directly from the train station, catering to the needs of travellers.

Despite the central location, Ginevra Rooms is easily accessible by car, as two nearby covered public car parks are available for long-term parking as well.

The location of the property allows easy access to many tourist and cultural attractions, including the exceptional Accademia Carrara, the Donizzetti theater with its music festivals, the funicular that climbs up to the Upper Town, the city's courthouse, central professional studios and shopping streets, all within walking distance.

My father's architecture studio was transformed into a sophisticated location inspired by the world's most famous watches. The four rooms are named after Rolex, Cartier, Patek, and Vacheron, each with a distinctive atmosphere and furnishings carefully crafted with particular attention to modern details.

Ciao sono Flavio, abito a Milano,  ma sono originario di questa meravigliosa Val Taleggio, che ha il potere con la sua semplicità e bellezza di lasciare sempre ricordi indelebili sia nella mia che nella memoria dei miei ospiti. 

Un oasi di pace e relax immersa nella natura a circa un ora dalle città di Bergamo e Milano, vicina ai servizi ma giustamente isolata dal caos e dalla frenesia, dove mi rifugio ogni volta possibile. 

Ideale per pause rigeneranti a contatto con la natura. Perfetta per gli amanti delle passeggiate nei boschi, della pesca sportiva alla trota, dello sci alpino, dei funghi porcini da cercare nei boschi dietro casa, ma anche a due passi da terme e piscine meravigliose.

Un posto ideale in cui passare giornate in con i propri amati, oziando su una sdraio in giardino o esplorando a piedi o in bici i dintorni. 

Prodotti enogastronomici genuini, biologici e golosi potranno essere acquistati direttamente dai produttori locali, che con antica maestrie vi daranno riscoprire i sapori di in tempo. 

Un luogo senza tempo, dove ritrovarsi e perdersi dolcemente. 

Vi aspetto. 

Flavio

neighborhood_overview:
The Locanda Mimmo is surrounded by:
VENETIAN WALLS
The walls of Bergamo, one of the most famous fortifications built by Venice, constituted the Republic’s westernmost defence system, while the fortress of Famagusta, on the island of Cyprus, was the Venetian outpost located farthest to the east. Never used for military purposes, from the nineteenth century the walls became a privileged site for taking a stroll, after the bastions and battlements were converted into a park.

PIAZZA VECCHIA
Fully completed in the mid-1400s with the demolition of various buildings and incorporating an older and small square, in the place where the grain and fodder market was once held, for centuries it was the representative seat of the city government. The home of the Venetian Podesta’ rises up to the west. The Civic Tower overlooks the square. A fountain donated to the city in 1780 by the Podesta' Alvise Contarini stands in the centre of the square.

Curiosity

neighborhood_overview:
The favorable geographical position of Predore makes it the ideal place for a holiday in close contact with nature, but at the same time close to many places of sporting and cultural interest.
For nature lovers there is the possibility of hiking, horseback riding or mountain biking in the hills or in the Orobic Prealps but also to visit sites of considerable natural interest (such as the Pyramids of Zone) or to make trips to Lake Iseo and to the splendid Montisola, the largest island of European lakes.
For culture lovers we recommend the Tadini Academy of Lovere, the Rock Engravings of the Camonica Valley, Pisogne with the frescoes by Romanino, Trescore with the frescoes by Lotto, Bergamo and Brescia with their important artistic, historical and architectural heritage.
Not to be forgotten, for wine lovers and good food lovers, are the food and wine itineraries that will lead you to the discovery of renowned and highly prized Franciacorta and ValCalepio products.

name: La Cà Dol Sùl
description:
Là Cà Dòl Sùl located in Orezzo, a hamlet of Gazzaniga, in the middle of the Seriana Valley, 700 meters above sea level on the slopes of Mount Poieto, enjoys an excellent view.
The cozy two-room apartment on the second floor, with a reserved parking space, private entrance and a small garden is kissed by the sun every day of the year. This is where Ilenia and Roberto got their inspiration for the name “Là Cà Dòl Sùl” in Bergamo dialect means the house of the sun. – REGIONAL CODE (CIR) 016111-CNI-00002 -
neighborhood_overview:
Just 100 meters from Là Cà Dòl Sùl is the CAI 523 path that leads to the top of Mount Poieto, a former ski resort at 1360 meters above sea level, in a couple of hours on foot.
Following the Os-Cioel 519 path, in an hour you arrive in the pristine Val de Grù, while taking the 523 you arrive in the suggestive Valle Vertova, an ideal destination in the summer where in certain points you can swim in the crystal clear water.
In addition, Là Cà Dòl Sùl is located halfway along the winding Seriana Valley and with a few km you can reach all the peaks of the Orobic Prealps, ideal destinations for those who love summer hiking and for those who practice winter sports where there are 7 ski resorts.
Another interesting destination, especially in the summer, is the Serio River, which gave the valley its name. The Serio waterfalls are famous and spectacular, and at 365 meters, they are the highest in Italy.

neighborhood_overview:
Riva di Solto is an enchanting place that gives a sense of authenticity and serenity unique on Lake Iseo. At the foot of a sunny hill full of olive trees, Riva di Solto is really a stone's throw from the lake.
This place is suitable for all types of tourism. From those who want to rest and take a walk in complete tranquility to those who want to do some sport.
For sports lovers, nearby you can find facilities that offer various sports, including: windsurfing, kitesurfing, kayaking, sailing, tennis, swimming and much more.
For nature lovers, there are various walking and cycling trails that will make you rediscover the lake from a different point of view.
In addition, from the port of Riva di Solto you can take the boat that takes you directly to Monte Isola and other locations on the lake.

Porta Nuova, which once marked the border of the city, is now the centre of lower Bergamo and is just a 5-minute walk from the flat.

Just 90 metres from the flat entrance is the oldest place of worship in lower Bergamo, the church of San Leonardo, built before the year 1000 and dedicated to the saint in the year 1017

The city is crossed by the Sentierone, a street running from east to west, bordered at either end by the Church of San Bartolomeo and Piazza Pontida, and is Bergamo's shopping destination par excellence. Other attractions include the Donizetti Theatre, the Carrara Academy and the Gallery of Modern and Contemporary Art (GAMeC). About 16 km away you will find the facilities of the Colere district, the jewel in the crown of the Val di Scalve, with slopes of up to 7 km and differences in altitude of 1200 metres, ideal for skiers and snowboarders.

Located just steps from the heart of Bergamo, Borgo Palazzo is a neighborhood full of historical charm and local authenticity. Strolling through its streets, you’ll admire traditional Lombard architecture, with old houses and artisan shops that tell the story of the area. The neighborhood is known for its blend of modernity and tradition, offering a range of restaurants, cafes, and local shops where you can taste Bergamasque cuisine or discover regional specialties.

Borgo Palazzo is well connected to both the city center and the renowned Città Alta, the medieval, hillside part of Bergamo, easily accessible on foot or by bus. Here, you can experience local life, enjoying an authentic atmosphere and the quiet of a residential neighborhood, while still being close to the main tourist attractions.

neighborhood_overview:
Via Giorgio e Guido Paglia is a historic street in the heart of Bergamo, offering a fascinating journey through time. Beyond connecting two vibrant central neighborhoods - Borgo San Leonardo and Porta Nuova - this street represents a symbolic boundary between tradition and modernity, offering a strategic location to explore the city.

A century ago, this area was completely different: known as "Via dei Mille", it was dominated by cultivated fields and crossed by the Roggia Colleonesca, one of the many canals that crossed the Bergamo boroughs. The only buildings at the time were located along the current Via Guglielmo D'Alzano. The transformation into Via Paglia took shape at the beginning of the 20th century, marking the evolution of this part of the city.

But what makes this street truly special is its dedication to Guido and Giorgio Paglia, father and son, two heroic figures united by courage and sacrifice, despite belonging to two seemingly opposite worlds.

Service and comfort

The area is well served by supermarkets, pharmacies, schools, bars and restaurants, as well as various convenience stores. Sports centers and green areas ideal for walking, jogging or relaxing outdoors are also within walking distance.

Solto Collina is a village located on the hills overlooking Lake Iseo, with a history that has its roots in the 11th century. The historic center is characterized by cobbled streets, stone buildings and, at times, a breathtaking view of the lake and the surrounding mountains.​
History and Architecture
In Contrada Castello is the ancient residence of the Lords of Solto, a castle dating back to the 12th century, with limestone walls and embrasures that tell centuries of history.

Places of Worship
The Church of Santa Maria Assunta, documented as early as the 12th century, is the town's main place of worship. Inside are important works of art, such as the Annunciation of the Virgin by Domenico Carpinoni and an organ by Andrea Fantoni. ​
Another place of interest is the Church of San Defendente, located 674 meters above sea level. In addition to its spiritual value, it offers spectacular panoramic views of the lake and the surrounding mountains.

This neighborhood, located in the center of Bergamo Bassa, is a charming neighborhood that preserves the charm of a historic Italian village. This is a narrow and evocative street, lined with ancient buildings, noble palaces, artisan shops and small cafes, which gently lead to the Upper City.

The atmosphere is quiet but lively, with a mix of local residents, artists, and curious tourists.
